headline: WHICH IS REAL?
titleSynergy: Claude Code + REA Cloned This App in 20 Minutes (Can You Spot the Real One?)
story: Two near-identical Kanban boards side by side: the real open-source app and the copy Claude Code + REA built from one link. The viewer is asked to pick.
curiosity: They look the same — which one did the AI make? The answer is in the video (5:04 reveal).
composition: Two equal tilted panels across the top two-thirds with a ? badge on each; one-line headline underneath, centred. No face, so the pair is the single focal point.
evidence: assets/evidence/wekan_crop.png and rea_crop.png — the same stills used in the video's side-by-side reveal, from Kalyan's screen recording 114559.
background: Ink with a soft coral glow; nothing generated.
typography: Inter Display Black 118 px, white with REAL in coral.
colors: Ink, coral, white; the boards bring orange/green which echo the coral.
canva: Panels baked as separate image layers; ? badges as shapes + native text; headline native text.
why: vidIQ penalised a reference for an unclear comparison — this makes the side-by-side the whole thumbnail
Similar-thumbnail search found no REA 'spot the real one' thumbnails
risks: No face: may feel less personal on a tiny channel
At 320 px the boards read as 'two similar screens', not details — that is the point
